name: curl
description: Command-line tool and library for transferring data with URLs.
summary: curl accepts AI-assisted code as long as it meets the project's normal quality and licensing requirements. AI-assisted issue reports must disclose AI use and be carefully verified by the reporter, while project communication should be concise and written in the contributor's own human voice rather than pasted AI-generated text.

evidence.quote: We can accept code written with the help of AI into the project, but the code must still follow coding standards, be written clearly, be documented, feature test cases and adhere to all the normal requirements we have.
If you asked an AI tool to find problems in curl, you **must** make sure to reveal this fact in your report.
You must also double-check the findings carefully before reporting them to us to validate that the issues are indeed existing and working exactly as the AI says.
When communicating in the curl project, please explain your issues or improvements briefly and clearly in your own human voice.
Do not lazily paste massive, AI-generated explanations; as a contributor doing this infrequently, it is your responsibility to invest a few extra minutes into making your message digestible.
